items.text: Ourlime Communities Network ("Ourlime," "we," "our," or "us") is operated by Uptech Incorporated Ltd. Ourlime is committed to maintaining a safe, respectful, productive, and trustworthy environment for all users. This Safety Policy explains the standards, systems, and actions used by Ourlime to help protect users from harmful behaviour, abusive content, scams, exploitation, threats, harassment, unsafe interactions, and other risks that may arise through online communication and community networking. This Policy should be read together with Ourlime's:
Copyright and Intellectual Property Policy; and

Ourlime is designed to help individuals, students, educators, entrepreneurs, professionals, businesses, organizations, and communities communicate, collaborate, learn, network, create, and discover opportunities. We recognize that online platforms can also be misused. Ourlime therefore takes reasonable measures to reduce risks involving:
Safety is a shared responsibility between Ourlime and the users who participate in the platform.
This Safety Policy applies across the Ourlime Communities Network, including:
Any other current or future Ourlime feature that allows users to communicate, upload content, interact, transact, or collaborate.
All users are expected to use Ourlime responsibly. Users should:
Use caution when communicating with unknown users;
Use blocking and privacy controls where appropriate;
Verify commercial or employment opportunities before committing money or sensitive information;
Never share passwords or authentication codes;
Protect children and vulnerable users; and

Ourlime provides users with mechanisms to report content, accounts, communities, communications, listings, events, or other activity that may violate our policies. Users may report concerns involving:
Reports should be submitted in good faith and should include sufficient information to allow Ourlime to review the issue.
Where available, users may report content or behaviour directly from within Ourlime. Depending on the feature involved, users may be able to report:
Ourlime may provide reporting categories to help users identify the nature of the concern.
Certain safety reports may be treated as high priority. These may include reports involving:
Other situations presenting a substantial risk of harm.
Ourlime may take immediate protective action while reviewing high-risk reports.
Ourlime may provide tools that allow users to block or restrict interaction with another user. Depending on the feature, blocking may prevent another user from:
Inviting a user to groups or communities; or
Blocking should be used when another user's behaviour is unwanted, uncomfortable, or unsafe.
Ourlime does not permit serious or persistent harassment or bullying. Prohibited behaviour may include:
Publishing sensitive personal information to cause harm;
Harassing children or vulnerable users; or
Creating accounts for the purpose of targeting another person.
Not every disagreement, criticism, or argument constitutes harassment. Context, severity, frequency, and intent may be considered during review.
Users must not use Ourlime to make credible threats of serious physical harm. Ourlime prohibits content or activity intended to:
Where a credible and serious threat is identified, Ourlime may take immediate enforcement action and may cooperate with appropriate authorities where required or permitted by law.
Protecting children is one of Ourlime's highest safety priorities. Ourlime has zero tolerance for:
Any other sexual exploitation of children.

These matters are governed in greater detail by the Ourlime Child Safety Standards Policy. Serious child-safety violations may result in immediate permanent account termination and referral to appropriate authorities where required by law.
Ourlime prohibits sexual exploitation of any person. Users must not:
Coerce another person into sexual activity;
Use Ourlime to facilitate non-consensual sexual activity.
Users must not use Ourlime to deceive others for financial, personal, or commercial gain. Prohibited conduct includes:
Users are encouraged to verify offers before sending money or personal information.
Users participating in Ourlime Marketplace should exercise caution when buying or selling. Users should:
Meet in safe public locations for in-person exchanges where practical;
Inspect items before completing payment where possible; and
Marketplace activity is also governed by the Ourlime Marketplace Policy.
Ourlime may provide job, freelance, contract, internship, or opportunity listings. Users should be cautious of opportunities that:
Pressure applicants to move immediately to another communication platform; or
Appear inconsistent with the claimed employer.
Users should take care when sharing personal information online. Users are encouraged not to publicly disclose unnecessary:
Other information that could create a safety or identity-theft risk.
Extra caution should be taken when sharing information about children.

Where Ourlime provides location-related features, users should carefully consider what location information they share. Users should avoid publicly sharing precise real-time location information when doing so could create a personal safety risk. Parents, guardians, educators, and younger users should take particular care when sharing school, home, travel, or location information.
Users are responsible for taking reasonable measures to secure their Ourlime accounts. Users should:
Review suspicious account activity where available.
If Ourlime reasonably believes that an account may have been compromised, we may take protective action. This may include:

Users must not impersonate another person, organization, business, government body, educator, public official, or Ourlime representative in a deceptive manner. Users should report accounts that appear to fraudulently impersonate them or others. Parody, commentary, or fan accounts may be permitted where they are clearly identified and do not mislead users.
Ourlime prohibits abusive spam and malicious linking. Users must not:
Use automated accounts to harass users;
Mislead users into visiting unsafe websites; or
Users must not use Ourlime to distribute or facilitate:
Unauthorized access tools intended for abuse; or
Other software intended to compromise users or systems.
Legitimate cybersecurity education, research, and defensive discussion may be permitted where not intended to facilitate harmful activity.
Ourlime may restrict content that encourages users to participate in activities likely to result in serious injury or death. This may include:
Educational, documentary, awareness, or prevention content may be treated differently based on context.

Ourlime does not permit content that intentionally encourages, glorifies, or instructs users to commit suicide or serious self-harm. Supportive conversations, recovery discussions, awareness content, and educational materials may be permitted. Where appropriate, Ourlime may restrict content or accounts associated with serious safety concerns.

Ourlime does not permit serious attacks or threats against people based on protected characteristics recognized under applicable law. Discussion, debate, education, history, politics, religion, culture, and social issues may be allowed where they do not cross into prohibited threats, dehumanization, or targeted abuse.
Ourlime must not be used to recruit, advertise, facilitate, organize, or profit from human trafficking. This includes:
Suspected trafficking may result in immediate enforcement and reporting where required by law.
Community administrators and moderators play an important role in maintaining safe spaces. Community administrators are encouraged to:
Community rules may be stricter than Ourlime's general rules but cannot authorize conduct prohibited by Ourlime.
Private messaging must not be used to evade Ourlime's safety rules. Users must not use messages to:
Where permitted by law and Ourlime policies, reports involving messages may be reviewed for safety enforcement.

Event organizers must accurately describe events and comply with applicable law. Ourlime must not be used to organize events involving:

Other conduct presenting an immediate or substantial risk of harm.

Repeat offenders may be permanently removed from Ourlime.

Coordinating with others to circumvent enforcement.

Ourlime is not an emergency service. If a user believes that someone is in immediate physical danger, they should contact the appropriate emergency service, law-enforcement agency, or child-protection authority in their jurisdiction. Ourlime's reporting tools should not be relied upon as a substitute for emergency assistance.
Where required or permitted by applicable law, Uptech Incorporated Ltd. may:
Ourlime will handle such matters in accordance with applicable legal and privacy obligations.

Such information will be handled in accordance with Ourlime's Privacy Policy and applicable law. Access to sensitive safety information should be limited to authorized personnel where appropriate.
Ourlime intends to continually improve platform safety as the network develops. Safety features may include:
Not all features may be available to every user or in every jurisdiction.
While Ourlime takes reasonable measures to promote safety, no online platform can eliminate all risks. Ourlime cannot guarantee that:
Every user is who they claim to be;
Every harmful message will be detected;
Every user will comply with the rules;
Every interaction will be safe; or
Every report will result in enforcement.
Users should continue to exercise reasonable judgment and caution when interacting online and offline.
Uptech Incorporated Ltd. may update this Safety Policy as Ourlime evolves. Updates may reflect:
Changes to Ourlime safety systems; or
The "Last Updated" date at the beginning of this Policy identifies the latest revision.
This Safety Policy should be read together with:
Ourlime Copyright and Intellectual Property Policy

Ourlime Communities Network ("Ourlime," "we," "our," or "us"), operated by Uptech Incorporated Ltd., is committed to providing a safe digital environment for our users and to protecting children from sexual abuse, exploitation, grooming, trafficking, harassment, and other forms of harm. Ourlime maintains a zero-tolerance policy toward Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) and Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). Users are strictly prohibited from using Ourlime to create, upload, store, distribute, transmit, request, promote, facilitate, encourage, solicit, or otherwise engage with content or conduct involving the sexual abuse or exploitation of children. These standards apply throughout the Ourlime Communities Network, including user profiles, posts, comments, communities, messages, media uploads, videos, Limes, events, E-Learning areas, E-Projects, E-Hub, Marketplace, Jobs, and any other present or future communication or content-sharing feature provided by Ourlime.

For purposes of this Policy: 2.1 Child A child or minor means any person under the age of 18, unless applicable law establishes a different age for a particular legal requirement. 2.2 Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) includes content, conduct, communications, or activities that sexually exploit, abuse, groom, traffic, endanger, or otherwise sexually harm a child. 2.3 Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) includes visual depictions of the sexual abuse or exploitation of children, including photographs, videos, illustrations, computer-generated imagery, manipulated imagery, or other prohibited representations where applicable under relevant law. CSAM is prohibited on Ourlime regardless of whether a user attempts to characterize the material as entertainment, humour, art, education, private communication, or any other purpose that does not provide a lawful basis for its possession or distribution.

sections.title: Prohibited Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation

items.text: Ourlime strictly prohibits CSAE in any form. Prohibited conduct includes, but is not limited to: 3.1 Child Sexual Abuse Material Users must not:
Create, upload, post, send, share, distribute, store, request, trade, sell, purchase, advertise, link to, or otherwise make CSAM available through Ourlime.
Encourage another person to create, obtain, distribute, or share CSAM.
Use Ourlime to locate, exchange, advertise, or facilitate access to CSAM.
Attempt to circumvent Ourlime's moderation or safety systems for the purpose of distributing prohibited material. 3.2 Grooming
Users must not use Ourlime to establish or develop a relationship with a child for the purpose of sexual exploitation or abuse. This includes:
Requesting sexual or intimate images from a child.
Encouraging a child to engage in sexual activity.
Attempting to move a child to another platform for sexual communication or exploitation.
Building trust with a child for the purpose of facilitating sexual contact, whether online or offline.
Offering money, gifts, opportunities, employment, rewards, digital items, or other benefits in exchange for sexual content or sexual activity. 3.3 Sexualization of Children
Ourlime prohibits content or behaviour that sexualizes children. This includes content that:
Depicts children in sexually suggestive circumstances.
Encourages the sexualization or sexual exploitation of children.
Makes sexual comments about a child's body.
Requests or encourages sexually suggestive poses or imagery involving children.
Promotes or normalizes sexual attraction toward children.
Uses manipulated, synthetic, computer-generated, or AI-generated content to sexually depict or exploit a child. 3.4 Sextortion

Users must not threaten, coerce, manipulate, or blackmail a child using actual, alleged, or fabricated intimate or sexual material. This includes threatening to publish or distribute intimate material unless a child:
Continues communicating with an offender; or
Complies with any other demand. 3.5 Child Trafficking and Commercial Sexual Exploitation

Ourlime must not be used to advertise, recruit, solicit, transport, facilitate, promote, arrange, or otherwise participate in the trafficking or commercial sexual exploitation of a child. This prohibition applies to posts, messages, communities, job listings, marketplace listings, events, advertisements, comments, profiles, videos, and all other Ourlime services. 3.6 Inappropriate Sexual Interaction with Children Users must not engage in inappropriate sexual interactions involving children, including sexual conversations, sexual propositions, unwanted sexual contact, encouragement of sexual activity, or requests for sexual or intimate information.

Ourlime prohibits predatory behaviour directed toward children. Users must not use Ourlime's communication, community, networking, educational, employment, marketplace, video, event, or other features to identify, contact, manipulate, groom, exploit, or harm children. Accounts found to be engaging in predatory behaviour may be immediately restricted, suspended, or permanently removed. Where required or appropriate under applicable law, Ourlime may also preserve relevant information and report suspected criminal activity to appropriate authorities.

Ourlime provides users with mechanisms to report content, accounts, communications, or behaviour that may violate our policies. Where reporting functionality is available, users are encouraged to report suspected child exploitation or abuse directly from the relevant content, account, message, community, or other applicable area of Ourlime. Reports may include concerns involving:
Other violations of Ourlime's safety standards.

Users may also contact Ourlime's Child Safety team using the contact information provided in this Policy. Reports involving the safety of children are treated seriously and may receive elevated priority during review.

When Ourlime obtains actual knowledge of CSAM or other prohibited child sexual exploitation occurring through the platform, we will take appropriate action consistent with applicable laws, our policies, and our child-safety procedures. Actions may include:

sections.title: Restricting access to or removing prohibited content;
Suspending or permanently disabling accounts involved in serious violations;
Restricting accounts, communities, messages, uploads, or other platform functionality;
Preserving relevant account or content information where required or permitted by law;
Reviewing related accounts, content, or activity for additional safety risks;
Preventing known prohibited content from being redistributed where technically and
Cooperating with lawful investigations by authorized authorities; and
Reporting confirmed CSAM or suspected child exploitation to the appropriate authorities

items.text: where required by applicable law. Ourlime will not knowingly permit CSAM to remain available through the platform after obtaining actual knowledge of the material where removal is legally and technically possible.
Violations of this Child Safety Standards Policy may result in enforcement action. Depending on the severity of the violation, enforcement may include:
Restrictions on messaging or communication features;
Blocking attempts to recreate terminated accounts where appropriate;
Referral to law enforcement or child-protection authorities; and
Other actions considered necessary to protect users and the Ourlime community.
Serious violations involving CSAM, grooming, trafficking, sextortion, or other forms of child sexual exploitation may result in immediate account termination without prior warning.

Uptech Incorporated Ltd. is committed to complying with applicable child-safety laws and regulations in jurisdictions where Ourlime operates. Where Ourlime identifies confirmed CSAM or circumstances requiring a report under applicable law, Ourlime will follow established procedures for reporting the matter to the appropriate authority. Depending on the applicable jurisdiction and legal requirements, this may include reporting to:
The National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC);
Appropriate national or regional child-protection authorities;
Ourlime may cooperate with valid legal requests and investigations concerning child sexual abuse, exploitation, trafficking, or other serious threats to the safety of children.
When required or permitted by applicable law, Ourlime may preserve information associated with suspected CSAE or CSAM reports. This may include relevant:
Other information reasonably necessary for safety investigations or compliance with legal obligations.

The preservation of such information does not mean prohibited content will remain publicly accessible through Ourlime. Access to sensitive child-safety information should be limited to authorized personnel and handled according to applicable legal, privacy, security, and evidence-preservation requirements.

Ourlime encourages good-faith reporting of suspected violations. Users must not knowingly submit false reports, fabricate allegations, misuse child-safety reporting systems to harass another person, or intentionally interfere with legitimate safety investigations. However, users will not be penalized merely because a good-faith report ultimately cannot be substantiated.

sections.title: Privacy and Protection of Child Victims

items.text: Ourlime recognizes the sensitive nature of child-safety investigations. Information relating to potential child victims will be handled with appropriate care and in accordance with applicable privacy, child-protection, evidence-preservation, and reporting laws. Users must not redistribute suspected CSAM in an attempt to report it to Ourlime. Instead, users should use Ourlime's reporting mechanisms and provide sufficient information for our safety team to locate and review the relevant account, communication, or content.
Every Ourlime user has a responsibility to use the platform safely and lawfully. Users should never:
Request sexual or intimate material from a child;
Send sexual material to a child;
Threaten a child with intimate material;
Encourage a child to participate in sexual activity;
Facilitate the trafficking or sexual exploitation of a child;
Download or redistribute suspected CSAM; or
Attempt to conceal CSAE occurring through Ourlime.

If a user encounters suspected child exploitation on Ourlime, the user should report the account or content through the available reporting tools. If a child appears to be in immediate danger, users should contact the appropriate local emergency service or law-enforcement authority.
Ourlime is committed to continually developing and improving safety measures appropriate to the nature, scale, and functionality of the platform. These measures may include:
Detection and prevention technologies where legally and technically appropriate;
Appeals and review processes where appropriate; and
Ourlime may update its safety systems as technologies, risks, laws, regulatory requirements, and industry practices evolve.

Ourlime recognizes that younger users may face additional risks when communicating or sharing information online. Where Ourlime permits children or teenagers to access particular services, we may implement age-appropriate protections and restrictions designed to reduce risks associated with unwanted contact, inappropriate content, disclosure of personal information, grooming, exploitation, and unsafe online-to-offline interactions. Users should never pressure a child or teenager to disclose sensitive personal information, including their private contact details, home address, school information, precise location, passwords, financial information, or intimate material. Ourlime may provide additional safety controls, warnings, privacy settings, parental or adult controls, or age-based restrictions where appropriate or required by applicable law.

Ourlime may use a combination of user reports, trained reviewers, automated systems, technical safeguards, and other appropriate methods to identify potential violations of this Policy. Potential CSAE and CSAM cases may be escalated for specialized review. Where a violation is confirmed, Ourlime may take action against the content, account, community, or other relevant platform resource. Nothing in this Policy requires Ourlime to notify an offending user before taking emergency or child-protection action.

Where appropriate and legally permissible, users whose accounts or content have been subject to enforcement may be provided with an opportunity to request a review. Certain actions involving suspected CSAM, preservation requirements, law-enforcement investigations, or other serious child-safety concerns may not be eligible for ordinary appeal procedures or may require Ourlime to restrict the information provided to the affected user.

Ourlime Communities Network and Uptech Incorporated Ltd. will maintain child-safety practices intended to comply with applicable laws and regulatory obligations governing child protection, online safety, privacy, reporting of child sexual abuse material, and cooperation with competent authorities. Because Ourlime may be accessible from multiple jurisdictions, specific legal obligations may differ according to the user's location, the location of the company, and the circumstances of a particular incident. This Policy should therefore be interpreted together with Ourlime's Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Community Guidelines, and other applicable policies.

Uptech Incorporated Ltd. maintains a designated Child Safety Point of Contact responsible for receiving child-safety and CSAE-related communications, including notifications from Google Play and relevant authorities. For privacy, security, account-support, or general customer-service inquiries unrelated to child safety, users should use Ourlime's normal support channels.

Ourlime Communities Network ("Ourlime," "we," "our," or "us") is operated by Uptech Incorporated Ltd. Ourlime is designed to provide a safe, productive, inclusive, and engaging digital environment where individuals, students, educators, entrepreneurs, professionals, businesses, organizations, and communities can communicate, learn, collaborate, create, network, discover opportunities, and share ideas. A strong community depends on its members. These Community Guidelines explain what is and is not permitted on Ourlime and apply to all users, content, communications, communities, and services available through the Ourlime platform. By using Ourlime, you agree to follow these Community Guidelines together with our Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, Child Safety Standards Policy, and other applicable policies.
These Community Guidelines apply throughout the Ourlime Communities Network, including, where applicable:
Images, videos, audio, documents, and other uploaded media;
Any other current or future Ourlime service that permits users to communicate, interact, upload, publish, or share content.
These rules apply to both public and private areas of Ourlime where permitted by applicable law and Ourlime's Terms of Service.

Ourlime encourages discussion, disagreement, creativity, humour, debate, and the exchange of different perspectives. However, users must interact with others respectfully. We do not allow behaviour intended to seriously harass, intimidate, humiliate, threaten, abuse, or deliberately target another person. Prohibited behaviour may include:
Encouraging others to harass an individual;
Sharing private information to intimidate or harm someone;
Encouraging self-harm or violence against another person; or
Creating accounts primarily to harass another user.
Disagreement alone does not necessarily constitute harassment. Ourlime seeks to distinguish legitimate criticism, debate, humour, and disagreement from abusive or threatening behaviour.

Protecting children is one of Ourlime's highest safety priorities. Ourlime maintains zero tolerance for Child Sexual Abuse and Exploitation (CSAE) and Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM). Users must never use Ourlime to:
Create, upload, distribute, request, obtain, advertise, sell, trade, or share CSAM;
Sexually exploit or abuse a child;
Groom a child for sexual purposes;
Request sexual or intimate images from a child;
Engage in sexual conversations directed toward children;
Facilitate sexual contact with a child;
Threaten or blackmail a child using intimate material;
Advertise, solicit, facilitate, or participate in child trafficking;
Encourage a child to engage in sexual activity;
Use Ourlime to identify or contact children for predatory purposes; or
Facilitate any other form of child sexual abuse or exploitation.

This prohibition also applies to manipulated, synthetic, or AI-generated content that sexually depicts or exploits children where prohibited by our policies or applicable law. Serious child-safety violations may result in immediate and permanent account termination. Where required by applicable law, Ourlime may preserve relevant information and report confirmed CSAM or other qualifying child-safety incidents to appropriate authorities. For complete information about our standards and procedures concerning child safety, please review the Ourlime Child Safety Standards Policy.

sections.title: Sexual Exploitation and Non-Consensual Sexual Content

items.text: Ourlime prohibits sexual exploitation regardless of the age of the victim. Users must not:
Share intimate images or videos without the depicted person's consent;
Use intimate material for blackmail or extortion;
Secretly record or distribute sexual content where doing so violates another person's rights;
Coerce another person into sexual activity;
Distribute sexually explicit content involving a person without their consent.
Content involving children is subject to Ourlime's stricter Child Safety Standards Policy.

Ourlime is a community and productivity-oriented platform and is not intended to be a pornography service. Users must not publish pornography or explicit sexual content where prohibited by Ourlime's content policies. Prohibited material may include:
Fetish content primarily intended for sexual gratification where prohibited;
Other sexually explicit material determined to be inappropriate for the platform.

Certain legitimate educational, medical, artistic, documentary, or public-interest content may be evaluated based on context, applicable law, audience, and platform policies. Content involving sexual exploitation or children is never permitted merely because it is described as artistic, humorous, educational, or fictional.
Ourlime does not permit credible threats or content intended to encourage serious violence against individuals or groups. Users must not:
Make credible threats of physical harm;
Encourage murder or serious physical violence;
Celebrate or glorify acts of extreme violence in ways likely to encourage further harm; or
Use Ourlime to organize activity intended to cause serious physical injury.

Graphic content may also be removed, restricted, or otherwise moderated depending on its context and purpose. Educational, documentary, journalistic, historical, or awareness-related material may be treated differently where appropriate.
Ourlime does not permit serious or persistent bullying and harassment. This may include:
Creating fake accounts to harass someone;
Maliciously publishing highly sensitive personal information; or
Targeting minors or vulnerable persons for humiliation.
Users are encouraged to use Ourlime's blocking and reporting features when they experience unwanted interactions.

Ourlime encourages people from different backgrounds and communities to interact respectfully. Content that attacks, threatens, dehumanizes, or advocates violence or serious discrimination against people based on legally protected characteristics may be removed. Context matters. Discussion of discrimination, history, politics, religion, culture, identity, public policy, news events, academic subjects, and controversial issues is not automatically prohibited merely because the subject is sensitive or disagreement occurs.

Ourlime does not permit content that intentionally encourages, instructs, glorifies, or promotes suicide, self-harm, eating-disorder behaviour, or dangerous activities likely to cause serious injury. Supportive discussions, recovery stories, educational material, awareness campaigns, and conversations intended to help people may be permitted. Content that appears to indicate an immediate safety risk may be subject to additional safety intervention where appropriate and legally permitted.
Users may not use Ourlime to organize, facilitate, promote, sell, distribute, or knowingly participate in illegal activity. This includes using Ourlime to facilitate:
Other criminal activities prohibited by applicable law.
Discussion, journalism, education, prevention, research, awareness, and reporting concerning illegal activities may be permitted when the purpose is not to facilitate wrongdoing.
Ourlime must not be used to defraud or deliberately deceive other users for financial or personal gain. Users must not:
Sell goods the user knowingly does not intend to provide;
Collect financial information under false pretences; or
Use Ourlime to facilitate identity theft.
Users should exercise caution when conducting transactions or communicating with unknown individuals.
Ourlime prohibits abusive spam and manipulation of platform systems. Users must not:
Send large amounts of unsolicited commercial messages;
Repeatedly post substantially identical content to disrupt communities;
Use automated accounts to manipulate engagement;
Artificially inflate likes, followers, views, memberships, votes, or other metrics;
Mislead users into visiting harmful websites; or
Attempt to manipulate Ourlime's recommendation, ranking, reporting, or moderation systems.
Legitimate business promotion may be permitted in appropriate areas of Ourlime, subject to applicable rules.

Users must not impersonate another person, business, organization, government entity, educator, public official, or Ourlime representative in a manner intended to deceive others. Fan, parody, commentary, or community accounts may be permitted when they are clearly identified and are not used to mislead users. Users must not misuse Ourlime verification features, badges, credentials, or identity systems.

Respect the privacy of others. Users must not maliciously publish highly sensitive personal information about another person without authorization where doing so creates a meaningful risk of harm. This may include:

Special care should be taken with information concerning children. Never pressure a child to provide their home address, school information, precise location, passwords, financial details, private contact information, or intimate material.
Users are responsible for taking reasonable measures to protect their Ourlime accounts. Users must not:
Attempt to access another person's account without authorization;
Exploit vulnerabilities to access unauthorized information; or
Use Ourlime to compromise another person's device or account.
Security researchers who identify vulnerabilities should report them responsibly through Ourlime's designated security reporting channel where available.
Ourlime may provide tools that allow users, businesses, and organizations to publish employment, freelance, contract, internship, or other opportunities. Job listings must be genuine. Users must not:
Use fake employment opportunities to collect personal information;
Use job listings to facilitate sexual exploitation or trafficking;
Misrepresent compensation or material employment conditions; or
Users should independently evaluate employment opportunities before providing sensitive information or making financial commitments.

Users participating in Ourlime Marketplace or other commercial areas must accurately represent the products or services they offer. Users must not knowingly offer prohibited, illegal, stolen, counterfeit, fraudulent, or dangerous goods or services in violation of applicable law or Ourlime policies. Ourlime may restrict particular categories of goods and services even where those products may be lawful in certain jurisdictions.
